statement:
The recorded value of 950 psi is unsafe and incorrect because Reactor R-2 is only rated to withstand 600 psi, meaning a 950 psi setpoint exceeds the vessel's structural limit and creates a severe risk of a catastrophic vessel burst.

Because this setting poses an immediate danger to equipment and plant safety, I will not apply the recorded 950 psi setpoint to the relief valve. Please review and update the record with an appropriate setpoint strictly below 600 psi (and above the normal 420 psi operating pressure) before proceeding.
